input.quote: the amount of any other actual direct damages, up to the greater of $100,000 or the charges paid by Customer to IBM for the Services in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the accrual of the first claim related to the Services.
input.rationale: Caps are mutual and 12-months-fees based with indemnities carved out, but the floor is only $100,000 (vs USD 1,000,000 preferred), the basis is fees "paid" only, IBM excludes all liability for loss of or damage to our records or data (p0114) despite hosting them, and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. Redline raises IBM's cap, deletes the data-loss exclusion and adds Excluded Claims.

input.quote: This is IBM's entire obligation to Customer with regard to any claim of infringement.
input.rationale: IBM's indemnity covers only third-party IP infringement (with a credit capped at 12 months' charges as sole remedy) and does not cover breach of law, data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, while our indemnity extends to any Services Recipient claim "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services". Redline adds the missing IBM limbs and deletes the open-ended Customer limb.
